paper.title: GenCast: Diffusion-based ensemble forecasting for medium-range weather
paper.authors: Ilan Price, Alvaro Sanchez-Gonzalez, Ferran Alet et al.

thesis: This work helps open the next chapter in operational weather forecasting, where critical weather-dependent decisions are made with greater accuracy and efficiency.

reconstruction.scope: abstract-level graph with retained full text

nodes.title: Research question
nodes.body: What does the reported model reveal when the target system is simulated?

nodes.title: Choose model and boundary conditions
nodes.body: Here, we introduce GenCast, a probabilistic weather model with greater skill and speed than the top operational medium-range weather forecast in the world, the European Centre for Medium-Range Forecasts (ECMWF)'s ensemble forecast, ENS.

nodes.title: Run the numerical experiment
nodes.body: Weather forecasts are fundamentally uncertain, so predicting the range of probable weather scenarios is crucial for important decisions, from warning the public about hazardous weather, to planning renewable energy use.

nodes.title: Primary reported result
nodes.body: It has greater skill than ENS on 97.4% of 1320 targets we evaluated, and better predicts extreme weather, tropical cyclones, and wind power production.

nodes.title: Published conclusion
nodes.body: This work helps open the next chapter in operational weather forecasting, where critical weather-dependent decisions are made with greater accuracy and efficiency.
